mapper.select: SELECT ID AS RESV_ID, TYPE, BIZ_ID, MEMBER_ID, PET_ID, ROOM_ID, MEMO, TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, STATUS, CREATED FROM RESERVE R WHERE ID = #{resvId}

SELECT R.ID, R.RESV_NO, R.RESV_TYPE, R.MEMBER_NO, R.PET_ID, R.TARGET_ID, R.ROOM_ID, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.STATUS_CD, R.REG_DATE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies, P.BREED AS petBreed, S.NAME AS stayName, SR.NAME AS serviceName FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESV_ID = #{resvId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVE ( ID, BIZ_ID, BIZ_TYPE, MEMBER_ID, PET_ID, MEMO, STATUS, RESJECT, CREATED, RESV_DATE, RESV_TIME, CHECKIN_DATE, CHECKOUT_DATE, SYMPTOMS, TOTAL_AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{resvId}, #{bizId}, #{bizType}, #{memberId}, #{petId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{reject}, SYSDATE, #{resvDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{resvTime, jdbcType=DATE}, #{checkinDate}, #{checkoutDate}, #{symptoms}, #{totalAmount} )
